brief:
A documentary titled NAZA has triggered intense controversy in Israel by exposing military conduct in Gaza, the Guardian reported. The film gained particular prominence around Yom Kippur this year, when filmmaker Nadav Weiman detected growing impact despite efforts to suppress it. Critics have sought to silence the work, a fact that reflects its broad reach across Israeli society.

The documentary's examination of army operations has proved difficult to ignore within Israel, forcing public confrontation with documented conduct that authorities and opponents have sought to contain. The backlash itself signals the film's power to challenge official narratives surrounding the military's Gaza operations.
